summary: C++-style destructor wrapper: delegates to the vtable-set + tail-call initializer VtableSetSubCall_8aea, then conditionally frees the object when the low bit of a3 is set, and returns the object pointer.

operations.description: Call VtableSetSubCall_8aea(a1, a2, v6, v7, v8) to run the base stream-object initialization.
Test whether bit 0 of a3 is set (a3 & 1) to decide whether the object must be freed.
When (a3 & 1) != 0, call FreeWrapper_7bcf(a1) to free the object.

unresolved: Locals v6, v7, v8 are Hex-Rays artifacts (negative stack slots) and are passed uninitialized to VtableSetSubCall_8aea; their real values are unknown.
The exact meaning of the a3 flag bits (only bit 0 observed) is unknown; 'positive sp value detected' warning in the source suggests the decompilation may be unreliable.
Legacy ABI label 'Locale_Destructor_with_Conditional_Free' matches the observed shape but is not independently confirmed.
